What if your salary becomes ₹0 tomorrow? Your EMIs, rent and monthly expenses won't stop just because your income does. So, how long can your savings actually support you? In this video, Aastha Khurana breaks down a practical 3-month financial survival plan to help you manage your money if you lose your job. Learn how to calculate your financial runway, reduce expenses, protect your savings and find ways to bring income back while you look for your next job.
